groups.title: 1. System and fabric setup
groups.desc: AAA, system settings, fabric policies, node management, fabric inventory, firmware and scheduler (docs subcategories: System Settings, AAA, Fabric Policies, Node Management, Fabric Inventory, Firmware, Scheduler).

groups.title: 2. Access policies
groups.desc: VLAN pools, domains, AAEP, interface and switch policies, profiles, selectors and VMM (docs subcategories: Access Policies, Fabric Access Policies, Virtual Networking).

groups.title: 3. Tenant and networking
groups.desc: Tenant, VRF, bridge domain, tenant policies, L3Out and L2Out (docs subcategories: Tenant Policies, Networking, L3Out, L2Out; plus aci_tenant).

groups.title: 4. Application
groups.desc: Application profiles, EPGs, ESGs, uSeg, contracts, subjects and filters (docs subcategories: Application Management, Contract).

groups.title: 5. L4-L7 service graphs
groups.desc: L4-L7 devices, concrete devices, service graph templates and redirect (docs subcategories: L4-L7 Services, L4-L7).

groups.title: 6. Multi-Pod, Multi-Site and Cloud
groups.desc: Fabric external connection policy (Multi-Pod / Remote Leaf TEP), Multi-Site and Cloud APIC objects (docs subcategories: Tenant Infra Policies, Multi-Site, Cloud).

groups.title: 7. Monitoring and BAU
groups.desc: SPAN source and destination groups and match labels (docs subcategory: Monitoring).

groups.title: 8. Operational and utility
groups.desc: Configuration import/export, remote file paths, generic REST, annotations and tags (docs subcategories: Import/Export, Generic).

groups.title: 9. Other
groups.desc: Items with no docs page in the provider at this tag, so no subcategory to group by. Nothing here is guessed into another group.
